tipsCenter.detailIntro: Each selected tip is shown with original odds, required Units, simulated stake and net result. Amounts use the euro slider above and are calculated only when opened.
tipsCenter.detailFoot: When viewing “Overall”, up to ten tips appear per page. The overall totals above still include every selected tip. Historical 0-Unit tips count as €0 in the model.
tipsCenter.modelIntro: Calculated overall result for the selected group, excluding unlock costs. Past performance does not guarantee future profits.
tipsCenter.roiIntro: Each settled tip receives the same hypothetical stake, regardless of how many BetInsight Units are required to unlock it. A win at decimal odds Q yields (Q − 1) × stake in net profit; a loss loses the entire stake.
tipsCenter.roiMethod: Betting ROI = total simulated net profit or loss across the selected tips ÷ total hypothetical stakes × 100. Odds are stored reference values. Unlock costs, fees and taxes are excluded.
tipsCenter.roiExample: Example: Ten tips at €10 per tip. One win at odds 11.00 and nine losses yield a €110 payout on €100 staked: +€10, or +10% betting ROI. The stake slider changes euro amounts, not ROI percentage.
tipsCenter.roiDisclaimer: These figures describe past results. They are neither a staking recommendation nor a profit guarantee.
tipsCenter.roiExtra: At least one settled tip lacks valid odds, so the complete modeled result cannot be calculated.
